summary: Comprehensive architectural and implementation plan for TableSmith's Universal Visual Layer & Element Engine. Introduces direct canvas drag-and-drop with resize/rotate handles across all 7 editors, rich typography text boxes, section image frames with foreground/background layers and border controls, an interactive Tabletop Icon Library for inline and standalone use, and a pro editor suite with layer z-ordering, alignment tools, opacity masks, and undo/redo history.
